import "jsr:@supabase/functions-js/edge-runtime.d.ts";

const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = new Set([
  "https://amelen0612-hue.github.io",
  "http://localhost:8765",
  "http://127.0.0.1:8765",
  "http://localhost:8766",
  "http://127.0.0.1:8766",
]);

function corsHeaders(req: Request) {
  const origin = req.headers.get("origin") || "";
  const allowOrigin = ALLOWED_ORIGINS.has(origin) ? origin : "https://amelen0612-hue.github.io";
  return {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": allowOrigin,
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
    "Vary": "Origin",
  };
}

function json(req: Request, body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { ...corsHeaders(req), "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

type Stop = {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
};

function validStop(s: any): s is Stop {
  return s &&
    typeof s.id === "string" && s.id.length > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(s.lat)) && Number.isFinite(Number(s.lng)) &&
    Number(s.lat) >= -90 && Number(s.lat) <= 90 &&
    Number(s.lng) >= -180 && Number(s.lng) <= 180;
}

Deno.serve(async (req: Request) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders(req) });
  }
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return json(req, { ok: false, message: "Método no permitido" }, 405);
  }

  const apiKey = Deno.env.get("ORS_API_KEY");
  if (!apiKey) {
    return json(req, { ok: false, code: "MISSING_ORS_KEY", message: "ORS_API_KEY no está configurada" }, 503);
  }

  let body: any;
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return json(req, { ok: false, message: "JSON inválido" }, 400);
  }

  const rawStops = Array.isArray(body?.stops) ? body.stops : [];
  const stops: Stop[] = rawStops
    .filter(validStop)
    .map((s: Stop) => ({ id: String(s.id), name: String(s.name || "Punto"), lat: Number(s.lat), lng: Number(s.lng) }));

  if (stops.length < 2) {
    return json(req, { ok: false, message: "Se necesitan al menos 2 puntos con coordenadas válidas" }, 400);
  }
  if (stops.length > 30) {
    return json(req, { ok: false, message: "Sistema de Campo admite hasta 30 puntos por optimización" }, 400);
  }

  const byId = new Map(stops.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const circular = Boolean(body?.circular);
  const startId = body?.startId ? String(body.startId) : (body?.baseId ? String(body.baseId) : null);
  const endId = body?.endId ? String(body.endId) : null;

  let start: Stop | undefined = startId ? byId.get(startId) : undefined;
  let end: Stop | undefined = endId ? byId.get(endId) : undefined;

  if (startId && !start) return json(req, { ok: false, message: "No se encontró el punto de salida" }, 400);
  if (endId && !end) return json(req, { ok: false, message: "No se encontró el punto de llegada" }, 400);

  if (circular) {
    if (!start) return json(req, { ok: false, message: "Selecciona el punto de salida para la ruta circular" }, 400);
    end = start;
  }

  // Si no se especifica salida, conservamos el primer punto como salida fija.
  if (!start) start = stops[0];

  // Si no se especifica llegada, conservamos el último punto como llegada fija.
  // En circular, end ya es igual a start.
  if (!end) end = circular ? start : stops[stops.length - 1];

  const fixedIds = new Set<string>([start.id, end.id]);
  const jobs = stops
    .filter((s) => !fixedIds.has(s.id))
    .map((s, idx) => ({
      id: idx + 1,
      description: s.id,
      location: [s.lng, s.lat],
      service: 0,
    }));

  const optimizePayload = {
    jobs,
    vehicles: [{
      id: 1,
      profile: "driving-car",
      start: [start.lng, start.lat],
      end: [end.lng, end.lat],
    }],
  };

  let optRes: Response;
  try {
    optRes = await fetch("https://api.heigit.org/vroom/v0", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Authorization": apiKey,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(optimizePayload),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return json(req, { ok: false, message: `No se pudo contactar openrouteservice: ${e?.message || e}` }, 502);
  }

  const optText = await optRes.text();
  let opt: any;
  try { opt = JSON.parse(optText); } catch { opt = null; }

  if (!optRes.ok || !opt) {
    return json(req, {
      ok: false,
      code: "ORS_OPTIMIZATION_ERROR",
      status: optRes.status,
      message: opt?.error?.message || opt?.error || opt?.message || optText.slice(0, 500) || "Error de optimización",
    }, 502);
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(opt.routes) || !opt.routes.length || !Array.isArray(opt.routes[0].steps)) {
    return json(req, { ok: false, message: "openrouteservice no devolvió una ruta optimizada" }, 502);
  }

  const jobIdToStop = new Map<number, Stop>();
  jobs.forEach((j, i) => jobIdToStop.set(j.id, stops.find((s) => s.id === j.description)!));

  const ordered: Stop[] = [start];
  for (const step of opt.routes[0].steps) {
    if (step?.type === "job" && Number.isInteger(step.id)) {
      const s = jobIdToStop.get(step.id);
      if (s) ordered.push(s);
    }
  }
  if (end.id !== start.id || circular) ordered.push(end);

  const coordinates = ordered.map((s) => [s.lng, s.lat]);

  let geometry: any = null;
  let summary: any = null;
  let directionsStatus: number | null = null;

  try {
    const dirRes = await fetch("https://api.heigit.org/openrouteservice/v2/directions/driving-car/geojson", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Authorization": apiKey,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ coordinates, instructions: true }),
    });
    directionsStatus = dirRes.status;
    const dir = await dirRes.json().catch(() => null);
    if (dirRes.ok && dir?.features?.[0]) {
      geometry = dir.features[0].geometry || null;
      summary = dir.features[0].properties?.summary || null;
    }
  } catch {
    // La optimización sigue siendo útil aunque falle el dibujo detallado.
  }

  return json(req, {
    ok: true,
    provider: "openrouteservice",
    route: ordered.map((s, index) => ({
      order: index,
      id: s.id,
      name: s.name || "Punto",
      lat: s.lat,
      lng: s.lng,
      role: index === 0 ? "start" : (index === ordered.length - 1 ? "end" : "stop"),
    })),
    summary: summary || {
      distance: opt.routes[0]?.distance ?? null,
      duration: opt.routes[0]?.duration ?? null,
    },
    geometry,
    directions_status: directionsStatus,
    circular,
  });
});
